lines.text: What if the *Moon* came ten times closer... for five seconds?
Right now it's about *384,000* kilometers away... and it looks tiny.
Ten times closer in three... two... one.
Ten times wider. A hundred times brighter.
Its pull on the oceans grows with the *cube* of distance. Ten times closer means a thousand times stronger tides.
But in five seconds? Nothing happens. Water needs *hours* to pile up into a tide.
And it would be closer to us than our *TV satellites*.
Follow for more. What should come closer next?
